## LuniOS 1.4.1 beta

Glass icons replace the Glassy apps experiment.

### New
- **Luni Labs: Glass icons** (experimental): your home screen icons turn into frosted glass. The wallpaper shows blurred through each tile, and the app's symbol becomes glass too. Works on the home screen, dock, folders, app drawer and search.
- Works for every app with one automatic method, no hand-made icons: LuniOS uses the app's monochrome icon if it has one, otherwise cuts the symbol out of the icon itself. Apps installed later work the same way.
- Turn it on in Settings > LuniOS > Luni Labs > Glass icons. Icons switch right away.

### Changed
- **Glassy apps** is removed. It only changed the window background behind apps, which most apps cover with their own, so it had almost no visible effect.

### Notes
- Updating from **1.3.0 beta** or **1.4.0 beta** works over the air.
- Icons that are photos or detailed artwork may look less clean as glass.
- This release includes the recovery images (boot, dtbo, vendor_kernel_boot, vendor_boot) for fresh installs.

## LuniOS 1.4.0 beta

Security gets a new face, and the setup wizard gets a fresh coat of glass.

### New
- **LuniOS security** (formerly Crescent): new name, a padlock icon, and a redesigned page in Settings > LuniOS. The padlock at the top shows the state at a glance: blue when your phone is secured, amber when something needs a look, red for a real problem. Below it: grouped glass cards for the security checks, USB protection and alerts.
- After updating you get a one-time **"Your phone is secured"** notification with the padlock.
- **Setup wizard:**
  - Same "deep space" background as Settings, and the liquid glass look of the rest of LuniOS.
  - A PIN-locked SIM no longer interrupts setup with the system SIM PIN screen right at the start. You enter the SIM PIN in its own step after Wi-Fi. If you skip it, the normal SIM PIN screen appears once setup is done.
  - A new step introducing LuniOS security.
- **Luni Labs: Glassy apps** (experimental): app windows show your blurred wallpaper through a soft glass tint. Works best in LuniOS apps; many third-party apps paint their own background and stay unchanged.

### Fixed
- The screen lock type picker (None, Swipe, Pattern, PIN, Password) no longer shows dark squares beside the options.

### Notes
- Updating from **1.3.0 beta** works over the air.
- Phones on 1.2.x or older still need the one-time clean install described in the 1.3.0 notes.
- This release includes the recovery images (boot, dtbo, vendor_kernel_boot, vendor_boot) for fresh installs.

## LuniOS 1.3.0 beta

A big trust and security release.

> **One clean install required.** 1.3.0 is signed with LuniOS's own release keys, so phones on 1.2.x or older **cannot** update to it over the air. Flash the recovery images below with fastboot, then **Format data / factory reset** in LuniOS Recovery and sideload the zip. Back up your data first. Updates after 1.3.0 work over the air again.

### New
- **Own signing keys:** LuniOS is now signed with private LuniOS release keys instead of the public test keys. Only official LuniOS builds can update your phone.
- **Production build:** LuniOS is now a `user` build (`release-keys`) instead of a debug build, like a phone from a store.
- **Crescent:** a new security center in Settings > LuniOS. It checks SELinux, the build signature, security patch age, encryption and screen lock, USB debugging and developer options, and explains the bootloader state honestly. It can warn you about real problems, remind you when USB debugging stays on, and restrict USB data (always, when unlocked, or never).
- A one-time **Meet Crescent** notification after installing or updating.
- The LuniOS license now ships with the system.

### Changed
- The updater only accepts a custom update server on debug builds. Official builds always use the official LuniOS feed.

### Notes
- This release includes the recovery images (boot, dtbo, vendor_kernel_boot, vendor_boot) needed for the clean install.

## LuniOS 1.2.2 beta

A small fix-up release.

### Fixed
- **Luni Labs unlock:** every tap on **LuniOS version** now counts toward unlocking Luni Labs, at any speed, just like Developer options. Before, fast taps opened the easter egg instead and Labs could not be unlocked.
- After unlocking, tapping the version again tells you Luni Labs is already unlocked.

### Changed
- **Moon easter egg** moved to the LuniOS logo at the top of Settings (LuniOS page, About LuniOS and About phone). Tap the logo 5 times quickly; it jiggles on every tap.

### Notes
- This release also includes the recovery images (boot, dtbo, vendor_kernel_boot, vendor_boot) for fresh installs.

## LuniOS 1.2.1 beta

### New: Luni Labs
A hidden page for experimental features. To unlock it, go to Settings > About phone and tap **LuniOS version** 7 times at a steady pace (about once per second). Luni Labs then shows up at the bottom of the LuniOS section. You can hide it again from inside the page.

### Experiment: Island notifications
When turned on in Luni Labs, incoming notifications appear in **Luna Island** instead of the regular pop-up:
- A glass card opens from the camera cutout with the app, title, message and avatar.
- Up to 3 action buttons from the app (e.g. Mark as read, Archive).
- Tap the card to open the app, swipe up to dismiss. The card closes on its own after 6 seconds, and the notification stays in the shade.
- Calls, alarms and the lock screen keep the regular style.
- Reply actions open the app for now. Inline replies are coming later.

### Notes
- Island notifications are experimental and off by default.

## LuniOS 1.2.0 beta

### New
- **Luna Island** – a live glass pill around the camera cutout that appears when something is going on: calls, timers and stopwatches, navigation, screen recording, media and plugging in the charger. When nothing is active, it hides. Tap to expand it into a glass card, tap the card to open the app, long-press to jump straight to the app.
- **Lock screen notification stack** – notifications on the lock screen now stack like cards: newest on top, older ones collapse into a stacked deck at the bottom with a "+N more" counter.
- **Glass everywhere** – liquid glass with blur and jelly press for the launcher long-press menu, shortcuts and drop targets, the share sheet, the volume panel, system dialogs and the power menu.

### Improved
- Settings: centered glass title pill, smooth scrolling under the top bar with no flicker.
- Updater: fresh update checks (no stale cache), no false "installation failed" after reboot.

### Notes
- Beta channel build. Your data is kept when you update over the air.

## LuniOS 1.1.1 Beta

A fix-up release for Settings and LuniOS Updates.

- **Settings:** lists now scroll smoothly under the transparent top bar. Rows no longer get cut off on a line or leave an empty frame, and they fade gently into the background near the top. The back button and the title pill always stay on top.
- **What's new screen:** after every update, the LuniOS logo rises like in the setup wizard and shows what changed in the new version.
- **LuniOS Updates:**
  - No more false "Installation failed" message after a successful update.
  - New releases show up right away, without waiting for the server cache.
  - Beta channel releases appear only when the Beta channel is selected.

## LuniOS 1.1 (test)

The first over-the-air update, straight from Settings.

- **Settings:** cards scroll smoothly under the transparent top bar. No more rows cut off on a line or an empty frame at the top.
- **Title bar:** the title in the centered glass pill is visible on every page.
- **LuniOS Updates:** checks, downloads and installs updates in the background to the second slot.
